description: Read the repository-native release plan, apply explicit approve/reject/defer decisions, generate grounded Task/contract drafts, deterministically validate drafts on a real target, or explicitly promote fully replay-validated drafts into reviewed repository-native artifacts. Review changes only decision metadata. Generation writes under .tapp/proposals, never overwrites, never invokes AI, and remains untrusted until real deterministic replay passes. Web validation can build/start/stop the detected managed target when url is omitted.

appBundleId.description: Validate iOS: installed application bundle id

approve.description: Plan item ids or names to approve

defer.description: Plan item ids or names to defer

items.description: Validate/promote only these plan item ids or names; defaults to every matching draft

platform.description: Validate: target platform; inferred when all selected drafts use one platform

projectDir.description: Generate: repo-relative project root containing the scoped .tapp Task directories

reject.description: Plan item ids or names to reject

target.description: Validate managed web: target id, name, or source path when the repository has multiple browser targets

url.description: Validate web: already-running owned URL; omit to use Tapp's managed target lifecycle

name: tapp_release_plan
title: Inspect or explicitly review a Tapp release plan
